entities.name: Erez Gerstein

entities.summary: Erez Gerstein was an Israeli Brigadier General who commanded the Israel Defense Forces Lebanon Liaison Unit and died in the South Lebanon conflict (1985–2000) with Hezbollah and Lebanese proxy militias.
